products.title: Console Table - Calix - 238 cm - By Baxter
products.description_html:
The Calix collection of wooden coffee tables and consoles by Baxter captures a refined elegance, drawing inspiration from the pure elegance of nature with its sculptural, rounded lines. Each element conveys a conversation between tradition and innovation. The sturdy frame, made from solid lime wood, takes centre stage with its polished black shellac finish, which beautifully highlights the wood's natural grain. The matt scratched shelf introduces a tactile and visual contrast, adding depth and character. The sinuous and organic forms of Calix recall the timeless elegance of ethnic and ritual art transformed into a functional work. Available in different sizes, the coffee table and console lend themselves to multiple furnishing interpretations, embracing a cultured and sophisticated taste.

DIMENSIONS :

W. 238 cm | D. 30 cm | H. 60 cm

products.title: Coffee Table - Aegates - 6 - By Baxter
products.description_html:
Each coffee table in the Aegates collection is an unusual, ironic island, a combination of joints and gaps with an organic shape that seems smoothed by the flow of water and time. The single coffee table can be arranged in pairs – for a versatile double tabletop – or in multiple tabletop compositions, reminiscent of the archipelago of islands from which the name is derived and to best meet the changing demands of life and space. The functionality of the tabletop (in different heights and sizes) is combined with the originality of the nature-inspired design and the variety of available finishes. From poplar briar, which forms the larger pieces, to the glossy, vibrant colours of the lacquered variants, available for small and large tables.

DIMENSIONS: 
W. 86 cm | D. 117 cm | H. 28 cm 

Available in 100 gloss lacquered MDF or in solid natural poplar briar.

The informal, versatile and welcoming character of this large modular sofa focuses all of its attention on the comfort of its guests. Placed in the centre of the living room, it invites you to take a seat on your favourite side with a simple movement of the roller backrests, facilitating complete relaxation or conversation depending on the situation.

products.title: Side Table - Icaro Night - By Baxter
products.description_html: The Icaro Night collection by Baxter expresses sophisticated elegance through the use of fine materials and essential design. This bedside table with drawers stands out for its leather upholstery, which gives softness and refinement to the surface, enhancing the linear and modern structure enriched by visible stitching. The solid base in matt black varnished metal lightly supports the defined volumes, while the attention to detail in the drawers offer functionality and practicality. The minimalist design of Icaro Night integrates harmoniously into elegant night spaces, adding a touch of discreet and contemporary luxury.

products.title: Dining Table - Grace - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Grace is a solid oak table which balances symmetries, asymmetries and dualities to encapsulate all of Baxter's material expertise. Christophe Delcourt's design invites you to shift your attention to what lies under the table top, which isn’t usually very visible, giving it stylistic importance. Here we find a succession of curves, arches, solids and voids, elements that catch the light and the eye. With its vibrant and timeless elegance, Grace's curved and generous top immediately grabs the attention to inspire ideas and inventions in a study or bring loved ones together in the dining room.

products.title: Coffee Table - Dune - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: Experimental and ironic, the Dune coffee table by Draga&Aurel is formed by a sinuous stainless steel band with a glossy finish on the outside and a satin finish on the inside, available in two versions: steel or natural fibreglass, with details in satin brass or chrome-plated metal. A sculptural piece with thin sheet metal that reflects light like a mirror, creating functional surfaces for a coffee table or bedside table in every curve.

products.title: Side Table - Copenaghen - 4A - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A visionary creation by Paola Navone, the Copenaghen tables elevate the concept of furnishing accessories into true functional sculptures. This exclusive collection plays with the purity of form to create an aesthetic experience of extraordinary refinement—where visual lightness and theatrical presence merge in perfect harmony. Finely crafted metal bases form airy, intricate structures that appear to defy gravity, elegantly supporting the precious metal tops above. These surfaces are finished to catch and refract light like natural prisms, transforming their surroundings with shifting reflections—reminiscent of wind-kissed water. Available in refined single or double-height configurations, Copenaghen tables integrate effortlessly into any contemporary interior, becoming focal points that illuminate the space with their distinctive character. True design jewels that transcend mere utility, they act as transformative elements within any setting.

products.title: Chair - Tia - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Designed by Antonino Sciortino, Tia is an outdoor chair that marks a tribute to the simplest and most perfect lightness and elegance. The chair's sinuous silhouette, accentuated by a matt black stainless steel rod frame, captures attention with its understated, essential elegance, while its rounded form, a hallmark of the collection, conveys a welcoming character. Crafted for outdoor environments like terraces and gardens, as well as for indoor areas seeking a minimalist flair, Tia seamlessly merges resilience with elegance, offering an ideal combination of aesthetics, comfort, and practicality.

products.title: Chair - Rimini - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The outdoor chairs of the Rimini collection by Paola Navone recall the timeless charm of the city synonymous with Italian holidays, a place that encapsulates the essence of summer. Featuring a refined vintage-inspired design, these leather chairs reinterpret the iconic atmosphere of the seaside resort, conveying a sense of enduring and understated elegance. Crafted with a sturdy tubular copper structure, the Rimini chairs come in two versions: Outdoor, showcasing a verdigris finish paired with a long-lasting and refined Aku leather seat, perfect for elegant outdoor settings; and Open-Air, boasting an antique copper structure with a Hydro leather seat, ideal for blending seamlessly into semi-sheltered areas.

products.title: Chair - Mati - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Solid and sophisticated, the Mati Outdoor chair stands out for its tubular structure in acid-etched copper that gives an authentic and refined look. The minimalist design, absent of any intertwining, highlights the purity of the forms and the visual lightness. The seat features a non-removable back cushion, available in leather or outdoor fabrics. Available in Lido leather or outdoor fabric. Mati Outdoor is crafted to adorn gardens, terraces, and sheltered outdoor areas with a sleek, modern aesthetic, providing an experience of sophistication.

products.title: Chair - Linfa - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: The most notable trait of Linfa outdoor seating is its unconventional irony. An approach that takes form in the harmonious balance of geometries, in the minimalist design of Studiopepe which interprets the contemporary outdoors in an unusual way: simple, timeless forms that stem from classic canons. Resting on a solid, painted swivel base, the stools and chairs in natural or black iroko wood invite us to reimagine our approach to the outdoors as a creative, rich opportunity to be explored in every season.

products.title: Chair - Leggia - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Leggia is an outdoor leather chair designed by Antonino Sciortino with the idea of combining elegance and minimalism in a strong and light seat, suitable for open air and outdoor spaces. Thanks to the sleek design of the stainless steel rods, the clean, minimalist silhouette of the frame contrasts with the comfort of the seat – upholstered in Aku leather for the Outdoor version and Hydro for the Open-Air version – which, suspended like a fabric, is ready to welcome those who sit down. The warm, natural colour of the outdoor leather adds depth, while the matt black painted steel emphasises the strong character of the chair, which blends into any context while maintaining a discreet and sophisticated beauty.

products.title: Chair - Himba - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Himba collection redefines domestic and outdoor spaces with ethnic-inspired chairs in natural, organic shapes that recall the typical motifs of African design and art. Delicate and harmonious, the solid wood seats designed by Roberto Lazzeroni elevate interiors in the version with leather cushions and can also be used on the terrace and in the garden when upholstered in weatherproof fabric or leather.

products.title: Chair - Dabliou - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Designed by Studiopepe for Baxter, the Dabliou chair is an outdoor piece that distils the spirit of Italy’s legendary 1960s beach resorts into a contemporary expression of sophisticated elegance. Its silhouette, defined by a coloured tubular structure, creates a dialogue between formal purity and precision in proportion. The result is a design that feels both visually light and structurally impeccable. The padding, crafted to coexist with the natural elements and endure their shifting moods, welcomes the body in a soft, embracing gesture—never compromising on aesthetic clarity or elegance. Dabliou transforms terraces, gardens, verandas, and dining spaces into unique settings—where signature design meets functionality, elevating the outdoor living experience. An iconic piece, versatile and expressive, perfect both on its own and combined with other elements to compose elegant and cohesive outdoor spaces.

products.title: Armchair - Zefir - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: With Zefir, Studiopepe combines design with artisanal mastery to craft an artwork that boasts a strong and distinctive presence. A tribute to lightness, this chair with its curved T-shaped backrest catches the eye with its perfect balance of geometric rigour and sinuous lines. Crafted from matt black metal, the unique backrest structure ascends like a graphic signature that shapes the space, softly embracing the guest. The leather upholstery, soft to the touch and made entirely by hand, transforms everyday comfort into an aesthetic and sensual statement. Zefir enriches the scene with its subtle balance between strength and grace, leaving a distinctive impression of strong personality.

products.title: Armchair - T Chair - By Federico Peri
products.description_html: The T Chair by Federico Peri is a minimalist design marvel, seamlessly merging practicality with understated elegance. The chair's geometric design is characterized by the distinctive 'T' shape of its padded backrest, an iconic feature that embraces the user, providing both comfort and personality to the design while imparting a sense of security and robustness. The seat's structure, crafted in polished glossy or matt black brushed wiredrawn aluminium, is welded at sharp angles and harmonizes with the inviting padding of the cushions, creating a captivating visual contrast. With its sober and decisive style, T Chair is a versatile piece of furniture, perfect to complete any environment, from the contemporary living room to the most formal dining room.

products.title: Armchair - Summer Arms - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Summer Arms armchair by Paola Navone, with its sleek and enveloping form, captures the essence of comfort through a distinctive and elegant design. The essential lines are enhanced in comfort and appeal by generous leather upholstered cushions featuring sharp edge stitching. The armrests emphasize the feeling of warmth and comfort, making the chair a perfect spot for engaging conversations around the dining table or worktop. For greater functionality, a version with castors is also available, perfect for appreciating the conviviality of the most lively settings.

products.title: Armchair - Stig - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Stig is a leather-covered chair whose design, by Roberto Lazzeroni, is inspired by the ironic furniture designed by Jean Royère. The chair’s distinguishing element is the base that becomes a sculpture and makes this small work of cabinet-making unique and immediately recognisable. It is a solid, thick sled made of wenge ash which, when raised, supports the seat and backrest. The two leather-covered cushions rest lightly on the structure and invite you to experience the unusual comfort of this statuesque piece.

products.title: Armchair - So Far - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Studiopepe's So Far chairs, with their luxurious upholstery, pay homage to an iconic design by blending 1970s influences with a modern elegance that feels as welcoming as an embrace. The tubular metal structure defines a bold and distinctive stage presence, which harmoniously dialogues with the soft and enveloping lines of the oversized seats. The combination of metal (available in hand-brushed burnished or glossy chrome finishes) and leather-covered cushions expresses a welcoming personality with timeless charm, able to enrich any living environment with style and versatility.

products.title: Armchair - Oslo - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Exuding minimalism and comfort, the Oslo chairs and stools by Paola Navone feature straightforward geometries that are perfectly complemented by luxurious leather upholstery, achieving an ideal blend of elegance and adaptability. The raw-cut stitching on the upholstery, exclusively available with leather legs, imparts a material sense to each chair and stool. Both functional and iconic, these chairs seamlessly fit into any setting, eliminating the distinctions between the living room, dining area, and workspace.

products.title: Armchair - Nepal - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Nepal chair, a bold creation by Paola Navone, redefines the concept of contemporary seating through a compelling contrast of elements: the extraordinary tactile softness of Mongolian fur envelops and embraces, while the solid frame outlines strong, architectural lines within the space. Each Nepal chair becomes a full sensory experience—an island of comfort that captivates at first glance and delights at first touch. The natural upholstery, available in a palette of luminous and vibrant hues, captures and transforms light, creating a magnetic focal point in any setting. Nepal is far more than a furnishing accessory—it is a stylistic statement that transforms its surroundings with exuberant presence; a living sculpture that invites both tactile and visual exploration.

products.title: Armchair - Miss Rope - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Striking and regal, Miss Rope is the woven paper cord chair by Studiopepe that, with its elongated design and high backrest, evokes the ceremonial seats and tribal thrones of far-off places. The weave draping the metal structure reflects the artisan's handiwork, where meticulous and steady movements bring the creation to life. The vertical lines, reminiscent of sculpture, convey the sitter's significance. Thanks to its expertly hand-crafted cord, Miss Rope is a majestic enhancement to both indoor and outdoor settings, owing to its remarkable resilience against outdoor conditions.

products.title: Dining Chair - Marilyn - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: Marilyn is the chair upholstered in soft leather that celebrates the idea of the “diva” according to designers Draga & Aurel. Available with or without armrests, it offers a versatile elegance, adapting effortlessly to various comfort and style needs. The swivel seat is wide and comfortable with voluptuous forms that are embraced by a light, aerodynamic shell which seems to defy gravity. With its vintage and fluid design, the chair is reminiscent of a padded nest, a soothing embrace that both cuddles and guarantees supports and freedom of movement. In the armrest version, the seating experience becomes even more enveloping, while the armless model maintains a sleek, essential line—perfect for dynamic interiors and compact spaces. The leather upholstery of Marilyn transforms under changing light, revealing subtle nuances and textures that add visual depth to its already striking presence. Versatile and distinctive, Marilyn enhances any setting with its sophisticated personality—from the dining room to the living area, and into the study. The option to customise the upholstery with an exclusive palette of colours allows this designer chair to integrate seamlessly into any interior concept—creating a focal point of undeniable allure.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones Mouton - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Lazybones Mouton is a sculptural chair with mouton upholstery designed by Studiopepe with the idea of creating a three-legged seat inspired by monoliths and primitive architecture. Characterised by archetypal forms, the chair plays with the structure’s massive volumes contrasted with the softness and comfort of the padding and mouton upholstery. Lazybones is characterised by three oversized, solid and imposing legs that emphasise its archaic solemnity. Its solid design fluidly interacts with the rounded, generous shapes of the backrest, making it ideal for leisure and social occasions.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Lazybones is a sculptural chair designed by Studiopepe with the idea of creating a three-legged seat inspired by monoliths and primitive architecture. Characterised by archetypal forms, the chair plays with the structure’s massive volumes contrasted with the softness and comfort of the padding and leather upholstery. Lazybones is characterised by three oversized, solid and imposing legs that emphasise its archaic solemnity. Its solid design fluidly interacts with the rounded, generous shapes of the backrest, making it ideal for leisure and social occasions.

products.title: Armchair - Jorgen - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Striking a balance between modern elegance and classical nuances, Roberto Lazzeroni's Jorgen chair displays a design that combines premium materials and meticulous details, achieving a perfect synergy of aesthetics, comfort, and functionality. The spacious seat, gracefully widened for arm support, is covered in soft leather and adorned with a subtle tone-on-tone decorative detail that emphasises its visual harmony. The wengé-stained ash base is distinguished by its sculptural stability, complemented by metal tips available in three refined finishes: satin brass, hand-brushed burnished metal, or satin nickel-plated metal. Every feature of the Jorgen chair embodies balance, comfort, and precision, transforming it into a piece of furniture that honours the seamless interaction between wood, leather, and metal.

products.title: Armchair - Jodie - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Taking inspiration from palaver-style seating, the whimsical chairs in Christophe Delcourt's Jodie collection best express the ideal of sharing, inviting guests to lounge and relax. The sinuous roundness of the forms enhances the designer's architectural choice, resulting in a refined interplay that shifts between sturdy, assertive lines and gentle, welcoming structures. The precious leather that covers each chair makes Jodie's sculptural lines extremely comfortable, in a masterpiece of design that provides a memorable seating experience.

products.title: Armchair - Inga - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Designed by Roberto Lazzeroni for Baxter, Inga is a collection comprising a high stool and chair that effortlessly merges Italian elegance with enveloping comfort in a refined, contemporary design. A natural evolution of the Inga pouf, the stool and chair are defined by their slender base and ergonomically shaped backrest that gently supports the sitter. The open cylindrical structure integrates a practical metal footrest, while the leather-upholstered padding offers an unparalleled comfort experience. Available in two different heights, Inga blends naturally into modern kitchens, islands and counters, as well as enhancing premium contract spaces. A subtle tone-on-tone decorative profile highlights the craftsmanship and attention to detail—making Inga a true symbol of contemporary high-end design.

products.title: Armchair - Himba - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Himba collection redefines domestic and outdoor spaces with ethnic-inspired chairs in natural, organic shapes that recall the typical motifs of African design and art. Delicate and harmonious, the solid wood seats designed by Roberto Lazzeroni elevate interiors in the version with leather cushions and can also be used on the terrace and in the garden when upholstered in weatherproof fabric or leather.

products.title: Armchair - Ginestra - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Magnetic and sculptural, Ginestra is the iconic metal rod chair designed by Antonino Sciortino for Baxter. From its circular seat to its majestic backrest, the chair features a matt black painted metal rod frame that gives spaces a rhythmic and dynamic feel, punctuating them with precise graphic contours. An interplay of geometric shapes alternating solids and voids, complementing the vertical appeal of the high backrest and giving the seat an unmistakable style and very striking effect.

products.title: Armchair - Gemma - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: With its ethereal profile, the Gemma leather chair by Draga & Aurel interprets the design codes of the 1960s, bringing them to centre stage in the dining room, study or living room. Versatile and unique, this alluring vintage chair engenders an atmosphere of consummate elegance thanks to the interplay of solids and voids created by the joints between the backrest and the armrests, and between the soft upholstery and the solid metal rod frame.

products.title: Armchair - Dolly Baby - By Doriana & Massimiliano Fuksas
products.description_html: Dolly Baby is a comfortable quilted leather chair characterised by a formal, composed and elegant design by designers Doriana & Massimiliano Fuksas. The slender legs in matt metal (with feet in a choice of finishes) and the tactile appeal of the leather upholstery, created using a special chequered quilting technique, make Dolly the ideal seat for those who love a more classic style combined with a strong, unusual personality.

products.title: Armchair - Corinne - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Roberto Lazzeroni designed the Corinne chair with the idea of reinventing the concept of hospitality through an extraordinarily calibrated design, simple only in appearance. Its essential profile, defined by fluid and decisive lines, reveals an elegance that is expressed in the details. The upholstered backrest, elongated with a refined design trick, extends gracefully to accommodate the arms, creating an illusion of armrests. The solid wenge-stained ash frame creates a formal contrast that dialogues with the enveloping softness of the upholstered seat and backrest. The upholstery, in leather or sheepskin, adds an irresistible tactile dimension, turning every encounter with Corinne into a unique sensory experience.

products.title: Armchair - Colette - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The refined design of the Colette and Colette Office chairs is inspired by what Roberto Lazzeroni calls “the infinite catalogue of memory”. The classic profiles of the two chairs, upholstered in the finest leather, recall the elegance of yesteryear, a simple yet assured style that fully embodies the link between past and future, between convention and experimentation. Baxter's own meticulous research into materials is evident in the way it pairs leather - a living, evolving element with a story to tell - with fine woods to create completely original combinations. The possibility of customising every chair - choosing between the materials, the armrests, the comfort of the armchair version - makes Colette a unique and exclusive piece, an iconic chair that enhances any space: from the office to the dining room, from the bedroom to the living room.

products.title: Armchair - Clotilde - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: An ideal complement for any table – not just in the dining room – Roberto Lazzeroni’s Clotilde chair stands out for its light and minimalist look, which reworks the vintage design of 1960s chairs with a bolder, more distinctive image. Clotilde has an ebonised ash or walnut frame, available in two different finishes, which supports the upholstered seat and backrest cushion. Through a clever design, the backrest has been extended so that it embraces the guest and allows functional support for the arms, without the need for armrests. The chair therefore becomes a new classic, a perfect icon on its own or combined with Baxter tables.

products.title: Armchair - Afra - By Baxter
products.description_html: With Afra, Baxter reimagines the armchair, elevating it to a sophisticated creation entirely wrapped in the tactile embrace of leather. Its ashwood frame—offered in a natural finish or in the deep tones of wenge-stain—traces elegant, sweeping lines that cradle the upholstered backrest, flowing seamlessly into arms that invite both comfort and contemplation. This masterfully composed design strikes the perfect balance between visual presence and lightness, transforming Afra into a timeless furnishing piece. Whether standing alone or placed gracefully around a dining table, this chair expresses a quiet yet unmistakable elegance, defining the space with the distinctive character and refined artistry that mark every Baxter creation.

products.title: Bed - Viktor - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The Viktor bed is a product of the partnership with the Draga&Aurel studio. A piece with a minimalist, elegant design that invites you to indulge in the comfort of the soft quilted cushion of the headboard. It is this welcoming surface that becomes the focal point of the model. The upholstered cushioning, covered in finely quilted leather and finished with delicate decorative stitching, rests softly on the headboard, encouraging you to rest. The feet in precious antiqued metal slim the classic lines of the structure, adding a touch of sophisticated lightness. Viktor is an iconic bed that celebrates Baxter's craftsmanship and expertise in combining materials.

products.title: Bed - Stone - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Sinuous geometries, rounded forms and soft volumes are the design features of Stone, a bed with a large padded headboard designed by Federico Peri for Baxter. The inspiration is the Japanese Zen garden with its bevelled stones delicately arranged in the sand according to a precise principle of balance and harmony. The Stone bed consists of an extra-large modular headboard which, with its rounded edges, resembles a river stone smoothed by time and water. A solid element that gently contrasts with the softness of the leather upholstery. The modular nature of the headboard also makes it possible to adjust the heights and widths of its components, which can be accessorised with single-leg tables complete with integrated adjustable light. One touch and the magic is revealed: the table lights up!

products.title: Bed - So Soft - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: So Soft embodies comfort and security. The rounded bed devised by Studiopepe for Baxter invites you to indulge in the embrace of its curvy, upholstered contours, gently contained at the corners by tubular metal details, available in hand-brushed burnished metal or polished chrome metal. Upholstered in leather, the bed’s soft contours give the feeling of a cosy nest of tranquillity, a reassuring refuge that encourages comfort and rest.

products.title: Bed - Paris Slim - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A bed that evokes comfort and relaxation, made with a simple and elegant design; Paris Slim fully represents the special characteristics of the union between Baxter and Paola Navone. The bed celebrates Navone’s attention to detail and ability to devise accessories with innovative and cosy designs like dog baskets, in which you can snuggle up and be cradled. Any rigidity is smoothed out by the fine, raw-cut workmanship of the leather, which rests naturally on the structure to form incredibly soft and comfortable upholstery, grazing the floor with fluid movements. Paris Slim is a bed that is as cosy as an embrace, a nest in which you can abandon yourself to complete repose.

products.title: Bed - Paris - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Paris is a bed upholstered in soft leather that elevates the idea of comfort and relaxation. Its design represents a perfect mix of elegance and comfort, the ideal synthesis of the union between Baxter and Paola Navone. The bed celebrates the designer’s attention to detail, her ability to conceive products with shapes as cosy as an embrace, in which you can curl up and be cradled. Any rigidity is smoothed out here by the workmanship of the raw-cut leather, which, resting loosely on the structure to form fine, ultra-soft upholstery, creates undulating movements that graze the floor with the smoothness of a tailored suit.

products.title: Bed - Milano - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Born from a desire for maximum comfort, Paola Navone's Milano collection includes the extra-padded leather bed: a generously sized piece with extra-large volumes and large, enveloping and reassuring cushions. The large bed is reminiscent of a cosy, welcoming nest inspired by the comforts of home which invites you to indulge in its soft, fluffy, cloud-like forms. The workmanship of the leather - quilted like a mattress and decorated by beautiful double-layered stitching - encourages you to fall into the embrace of the oversized padding of the headboard and allow yourself to drift off into a regenerating sleep.

products.title: Bed - Miami Soft - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Miami Soft leather bed adds a touch of extra comfort to the bedroom with a generous and welcoming design and refined leather workmanship that conveys all the sophisticated sensuality that Paola Navone brings to all her designs. The soft, curvy headboard and generous padded edges of this alluring modern double bed are an open invitation to lie down, rest and recuperate. A cultured and informal celebration of the warmth and intimacy of the bedroom, the corner of the house dedicated to rest and relaxation and true soul of the home.

products.title: Bed - Heaven - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: As its name suggests, Heaven is the bed for those who wish to elevate the sleeping experience to new levels of comfort and elegance. Designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, Heaven immediately stands out for its distinctive leather headboard. Oversized, with its hand-crafted tufted work and impressive upholstery, the headboard has a monumental presence that outlines and envelops the space and its occupants. The soft, extra-large contours of each element of the bed are like a cuddle that welcomes during sleep and makes the time spent in its embrace heavenly.

products.title: Bed - Couche - By Baxter
products.description_html: Couche Extra is certainly one of Baxter’s most impressive beds. The standout feature of the bed’s design is the impressive upholstered headboard, a monumental element made up of four removable strips, featuring leather upholstery finished with exquisite hand-stitching. The large headboard with a velvet back forms a soft shield, an extra-large barrier that protects the resting person from the outside world and envelops the bed in an embrace thanks to the possibility of moving the two additional side strips.

products.title: Bed - Clara - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: The Clara bed designed by Christophe Delcourt allows you to play around with the possibility of adding (or removing) a highly functional detail from the frame: the built-in bedside tables. The table tops are suspended and perfectly integrated in the organic lines of the large leather bed whose natural forms create concave and convex curves that encourage total relaxation and rest.

products.title: Bed - Casablanca - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Casablanca bed designed by Paola Navone for Baxter stands out for the refined simplicity of its forms. An informal, relaxed design made irresistibly inviting by its soft padding and leather upholstery. Spacious and elegant, the upholstered bed consists of a frame topped by a generous headboard which folds down to form two large pillows that invite you to snuggle down and sleep, read or just simply relax. An all-round celebration of our need to enjoy a well-deserved rest, a bedroom accessory of timeless elegance that lends style and originality to any home.

products.title: Bed - Aura Slim - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: A refined creation by Hannes Peer for Baxter, Aura Slim is a bed with a sleek, sophisticated profile that transforms the modern bedroom into a true sanctuary of elegance. A minimalist evolution of the iconic Aura model, it retains its sculptural soul while adopting a lighter, more slender silhouette—perfect for harmonising with contemporary spaces. Its distinctive base in folded aluminium—crafted using advanced folding techniques and available in exclusive chromed or lacquered finishes—offers a surprising floating effect, visually light and seemingly defying gravity. The robust inner frame ensures lasting durability, while the contoured padding embraces the body, guiding it towards deep, regenerative rest. The bed frame, wrapped in Baxter’s signature ultra-soft leather, adds a tactile dimension that gently envelops the structure, enhancing a refined design that elevates any bedroom into a place of quiet prestige.

products.title: Bed - Aura - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: Designed by Hannes Peer for Baxter, Aura is a double bed that redefines the sleep experience by combining the essence of contemporary architecture with exceptional comfort. A sophisticated evolution of the modular Aura sofa, this bed expresses graceful lightness through its floating aluminium frame—available in polished chrome or lacquered finishes that masterfully play with light. The solid internal structure guarantees enduring strength, while the sculpted padding cradles the body in a soft embrace, encouraging a deeply restorative sleep. Wrapped in sensuous, full-grain leather, the bed frame outlines the profile with sculptural elegance—transforming any bedroom into a space of refined beauty. The two generously padded headboards, meticulously shaped, create a harmonious visual flow while offering ideal ergonomic support. Aura becomes a symbol of contemporary luxury, designed for night spaces that aspire to both exclusivity and emotional warmth.

products.title: Sofa - Viktor - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: Viktor is the leather sofa which revisits the vintage style to express the simple elegance and understated and unostentatious beauty typical of timeless classics. Viktor by the Draga&Aurel studio is a research project on upholstery and, in particular, modular furniture, which begins with an exploration of 1970s atmospheres. The clean, linear design of the sofa, whose suspended base conveys a sense of lightness, hints at the strong and versatile character of the model, as exemplified by its modular nature. Viktor invites you to unleash your creativity and compose the piece according to your taste and space requirements, adding cushions or armrests, poufs or chaise-lounges to make the sofa even more personal and comfortable.

products.title: Sofa - Tia - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: With the outdoor lounger and flexible bench from the Tia collection, Antonino Sciortino reinvents the fundamental style of outdoor design, elevating simplicity into pure elegance. The rounded lines, sculpted in matt black stainless steel rod, give this furniture a surprising visual lightness, while maintaining a clean structural solidity. With their circular design, the seats form a distinctive element of the collection, wrapping around and defining each item. This imparts a unique identity to the furniture, counterbalancing the sharp linearity of the structure. These pieces seamlessly blend into any outdoor setting, untroubled by seasonal changes, while preserving an enduring sense of harmony and lightness.

products.title: Sunbed - Tia - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: With the open air lounger and flexible bench from the Tia collection, Antonino Sciortino reinvents the fundamental style of outdoor design, elevating simplicity into pure elegance. The rounded lines, sculpted in matt black stainless steel rod, give this furniture a surprising visual lightness, while maintaining a clean structural solidity. With their circular design, the seats form a distinctive element of the collection, wrapping around and defining each item. This imparts a unique identity to the furniture, counterbalancing the sharp linearity of the structure. These pieces seamlessly blend into any outdoor setting, untroubled by seasonal changes, while preserving an enduring sense of harmony and lightness.

products.title: Armchair - Thea - By Draga & Aurel
Armchair - Taipei - By Paola Navone
Armchair - Taipei - By Paola Navone
Sofa - Tactile - By Vincenzo De Cotiis
products.description_html: The Tactile armchair and quilted sofa collection showcases the tangible properties of leather with a statuesque design that gives the products a museum-like appearance and underlines Vincenzo De Cotiis' close attention to detail.

products.title: Armchair - Stromboli - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Stromboli armchair, a revolutionary vision by Paola Navone, boldly challenges the conventions of elegance in contemporary furniture design. In this unique creation, Baxter leather is freed from formal constraints to express its natural inclination for movement—shaping a landscape of folds and ripples that make each piece truly unrepeatable. The visual and tactile effect is surprisingly organic and vibrant—almost sculptural—inviting a deeply sensory experience. Stromboli celebrates imperfection as a superior form of beauty, with a contemporary design language that recalls the expressive fluidity of natural forms. This exclusive designer armchair is far more than a furnishing element: it is a manifesto of creative freedom, transforming the living space into a dynamic environment—an invitation to break free from convention and embrace a new, boundless dimension of elegance.

products.title: Armchair - Stig - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Stig is Roberto Lazzeroni’s armchair with armrests, a statuesque and playful piece whose inspiration comes from designer Jean Royère and his naively ironic furniture. The armchair’s sculptural design is characterised by a solid base consisting of a wenge-stained ash sled that supports the seat, back and armrest, comfort elements upholstered in soft leather. Satin metal or hand-brushed burnished finish details add a vintage sophistication to the armchair, which becomes the standout element of any room.

products.title: Sofa  - So Soft - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: So Soft is an ottoman and dormeuse collection that celebrates the comfortable side of living. Conceived by Studiopepe, the two rounded accessories enhance the space with new opportunities for comfort and socialising, in a vision of the living room as an inviting, relaxing place. This impression is accentuated by the leather upholstery, enhanced by the sinuous embrace of the metal tubular elements that contain its shapes. Here, ottomans and daybeds are reassuring oases, cosy refuges for taking a break, alone or in company.

products.title: Sofa  - Sorrento - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, the Sorrento furniture collection comprises a sofa and armchair with classic forms and generous dimensions, which here become a nest, a cradle, a refuge. The strong and rigorous frame with contrasting edges accommodates soft goose down cushions, as voluminous and light as clouds, in which to sink. The leather upholstery invites you to sit back in total comfort and includes small contrasting details reminiscent of mattress stitching. Designed for complete relaxation, the large armchair and sofa have a reassuring effect, transmitting a sense of calm and wellbeing in any environment.

products.title: Armchair - So Good - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Comfortable and sophisticated, the So Good armchair by Studiopepe encapsulates the essence of a design that is as essential as it is sophisticated, combining 1970s influences with extra-comfortable elegant lines. The tubular metal frame gives the armchair a sculptural presence, ideal for enhancing spaces that require furniture with a strong aesthetic impact. The leather upholstery of the oversize seat, a pivotal element with enveloping lines like a cloud, creates a harmonious dialogue between the different materials, offering exceptional comfort. The visible stitching of the cushions and the precious metal finish highlight the exclusive character of the piece, which is a true icon of style and versatility.

products.title: Armchair - Sellerina Alluminium - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Created from a one-piece unit in polished cast aluminium, the armchair Sellerina Alluminium by Paola Navone evokes the comfortable charm of more classic furniture, reinterpreting it with a completely innovative design sensibility. Inspired by elegant seats with a retro flavour, Sellerina embodies a contemporary vision of the art de vivre, combining sinuous and cosy shapes with unusual details and materials. The polished aluminium of the structure lends the design a bold lightness and surprising brilliance, enhancing its scenic presence. Sellerina Alluminium reinterprets the armchair as an eclectic and distinctive decorative piece, where minimalist lines and perfect proportions blend seamlessly with the metal's polished surface, equally honouring comfort and beauty.

products.title: Armchair - Rimini - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Rimini collection of sun loungers, chaise longues and ottomans by Paola Navone pays tribute to the quintessential Italian summer ambiance reminiscent of Fellini. With timeless elegance, the Rimini sun loungers encapsulate the carefree spirit of an Italian holiday with their refined and versatile design, perfect for gardens and poolside areas. In the Outdoor, each piece is characterised by a seat in durable Aku leather, suspended on a tubular structure in exclusive verdigris acid-etched copper. The Open-Air, on the other hand, features a Hydro leather seat that wraps around the body and supports it thanks to the acid-etched copper structure. The seat decorations differ based on the version and serve as an additional distinguishing feature: in the Lido leather version, the visible stitching conveys understated elegance, while in the Outdoor fabric version, the decorative piping — available in either solid or contrasting colours — provides the opportunity to personalise each seat's look with a broad range of colours.

products.title: Armchair - Pochette - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A timeless and extremely comfortable design that, on closer inspection, reveals unique details and elegant handmade decorations. Paola Navone's Pochette armchair is the perfect combination of classic shapes, timeless elegance and absolute comfort. The armchair is adorned with delicate decorative stitching that traces its contours, forming gentle folds in the leather exterior. Like a shell, it cradles the plush upholstery of the seat, enticing guests to relax against the elegant headrest cushion.

products.title: Armchair - Pillow - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: Enveloping and reassuring, Pillow is a soft armchair that guarantees both elegance and comfort, just like all Baxter pieces. Like any masterpiece, Hannes Peer's design is iconic in its simplicity: a balanced game of contrasts between the simple lines of the frame and the abundant forms of the seat, which seems to levitate, as light and airy as a cloud. The temptation of being pampered by the extra-large leather cushion is irresistible. The promise of an embrace that invites you into a new dimension of relaxation.

products.title: Sofa - Piaf - By Baxter
products.description_html: Socialising is the key word. Piaf is a sofa with a curved design that represents the ideal focus of the living room according to Baxter. A modular and cosy piece that redefines space with extraordinary elegance and generous, reassuring shapes. The model’s originality lies in a series of voluminous modules that can be played with to create compositions characterised by curves, a key element on which to lengthen the seats and give the piece ever new shapes. Surrendering to Piaf’s rounded, smoothed contours means allowing yourself to be enveloped in a comfortable embrace, a sense of protection and softness made irresistible by the leather upholstery.

products.title: Armchair - Pedro - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Infused with sculptural elements and material details, the Pedro collection's outdoor armchair and ottoman introduce artistic presences featuring exotic and essential lines into outdoor areas, able to blend into the environment outside the home. For the outdoor armchair, Roberto Lazzeroni designs a welcoming low seat with a generous, comfortable round cushion (in Aku leather for the Outdoor) and other cushions in technical fabric to lean against the high backrest reminiscent of thrones and tribal chairs. The enveloping stainless steel frame with cord details is designed to withstand the weather and inhabit outdoor spaces in every season.

products.title: Armchair - Pedro - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Infused with sculptural elements and material details, the Pedro collection's open-air armchair and ottoman introduce artistic presences featuring exotic and essential lines into open-air areas, able to blend into the environment outside the home. For the outdoor armchair, Roberto Lazzeroni designs a welcoming low seat with a generous, comfortable round cushion (in Hydro leather for the Open-Air) and other cushions in technical fabric to lean against the high backrest reminiscent of thrones and tribal chairs. The enveloping stainless steel frame with cord details is designed to withstand the weather and inhabit outdoor spaces in every season.

products.title: Bench - Pedro Indoor - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Linear with a strong core and a gentle seat, the Passepartout bench, born from Federico Peri's timeless design, merges elegance, adaptability, and comfort in an iconic model that enriches any setting with style. A design with a perfect balance that never goes out of style and stands out for the rounded lines and the leather that surrounds the long upholstered seat, inviting you to rest and relax. The base of the bench, solid and essential, is available in burnished metal versions with details in satin brass or in brass with bronzing oxidation and satin finish.

products.title: Armchair - Pedro Indoor - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Infused with sculptural elements and material details, the Pedro collection's indoor armchair and ottoman introduce artistic presences featuring exotic and essential lines into domestic areas, fostering a sophisticated and welcoming ambience. For the indoor armchair, Roberto Lazzeroni designs a welcoming low seat with a generous, comfortable round cushion, crafted from premium indoor leather, and others leather cushions to lean against the high backrest reminiscent of thrones and tribal chairs. The enveloping metal frame varnished with refined details is designed to blend harmoniously into the interior, offering comfort and style in every season.

products.title: Sofa - Panama Bold - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Comfort in its most flexible form. Panama Bold is the modular leather sofa created by Paola Navone to meet the need for versatility and well-being with an essential and cosy design, which represents an ideal of informal elegance. Ideal for any setting, the sofa features modular ottomans that accommodate large, soft cushions, easily transforming their function with a simple touch. Thanks to the internal counterweight that provides balance, the upholstered cushions effortlessly transform into armrests and backrests, adapting to your desires and needs. The evolving charm of Panama Bold becomes even more exquisite with the addition of soft leather upholstery and visible stitching, a sophisticated element that emphasizes the tactile qualities of the piece.

products.title: Sofa - Panama Bold - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Exceptionally comfortable and versatile, the Panama Bold outdoor modular sofa features a design that defies convention and seamlessly adapts to both open and large spaces. Created by Paola Navone, the sofa boasts comfortably upholstered seating comprised of soft and inviting ottomans, enhanced by adaptable cushions equipped with counterweights, which can function as either armrests or backrests.

products.title: Sofa - Panama Bold - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Exceptionally comfortable and versatile, the Panama Bold open-air modular sofa features a design that defies convention and seamlessly adapts to sheltered areas. Created by Paola Navone, the sofa boasts comfortably upholstered seating comprised of soft and inviting ottomans, enhanced by adaptable cushions equipped with counterweights, which can function as either armrests or backrests.

products.title: Sofa - Ortigia - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Ortigia daybed by Paola Navone is a new dimension in enveloping comfort, a welcoming embrace whenever you need to take a relaxing break. The smooth, rounded lines of the design are covered in soft leather and embellished by the quilting. With its cosy look, complemented by the large cushion, Ortigia promises to pamper, a generous piece to add to the living room or any other space for socialising.

products.title: Armchair - Olaf - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Olaf leather armchair fully represents Roberto Lazzeroni’s ethnic-inspired design. Olaf is a low armchair with an ironic, sculptural design that recalls African art. The seat and backrest, which extends to become an armrest, are upholstered in leather and, with their sinuous curves, supported by sturdy legs reminiscent of elephant legs, invite you to take a relaxing break.

products.title: Armchair - Nina - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Nina ottoman by Roberto Lazzeroni represents a new classic for convivial occasions. With its wrap-around backrest, the Nina's welcoming and elegant design seamlessly integrates into any setting, providing an ideal spot for enjoying moments with friends. The leather ottoman has a circular seat, which develops vertically outlining soft and essential shapes, contained by a decorative profile in the same colour as the seat and backrest or in contrasting colours. The soft upholstery guarantees comfort and well-being, enveloping the entire structure and preserving its striking presence over time while staying faithful to its iconic design aesthetic.

Sofa - Narciso - By Studiopepe
Sofa - Narciso - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Like in the legend of Narcissus, Narciso is the irresistible surprise one encounters in a reflection. Studiopepe's collection of outdoor chaise-lounge, modular sofa and armchair has comfortable profiles made vaguely irregular by the addition of big soft cushions, perfect for relaxing on in any season, which seem to be held together by the discreet and essential presence of a steel band. This cosy outdoor sofa can be composed according to individual tastes and requirements by adding chaises lounge, corner elements and comfortable poufs. Elegance, comfort and pure indulgence.

This cosy outdoor sofa can be composed according to individual tastes and requirements by adding chaises lounge, corner elements and comfortable poufs. Elegance, comfort and pure indulgence.

products.title: Armchair - Montreal - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: An invitation to comfort and relaxation outside the home, Montreal is Paola Navone's large upholstered outdoor armchair that is an ode to elegance in outdoor spaces. The generous dimensions of the soft upholstery offer a pleasant feeling of refuge and cosiness, making the armchair the ideal companion for relaxing in the garden, on the terrace or by the pool. The practicality of the non-slip rubber base and the versatility of the removable cover in a water-repellent material of your choice offer security, durability, and the possibility to customise each piece.

products.title: Armchair - Montreal - Paola Navone

products.title: Sofa - Milano - Paola Navone
products.description_html: Born from a desire for maximum comfort, Paola Navone's Milano collection includes the sofa and three leather armchair versions (corner armchair, small armchair, and bergère with swivel base) with generous dimensions and a design of enveloping and reassuring extra-large volumes. These sofa and armchairs are warm, welcoming retreats, drawing inspiration from the comfort of home, embraced by soft, cloud-like forms. The workmanship of the leather — quilted like a mattress and decorated by beautiful squared stitching — invites you to sink into the oversized padding and immerse yourself in total relaxation.

products.title: Armchair - Mickey Extra - By Baxter
products.description_html: With its gracefully curved armrests and welcoming upholstered design, the large Mickey Extra armchair is an elegant classic that brings a comfortable touch to any space. The decorative leather profile, offered in both matching and contrasting shades, accentuates the armchair's rounded and inviting design, encouraging relaxation on its generous structure with armrests and goose-down cushions. Elegant and timeless, the Mickey Extra is a large upholstered armchair that perfectly embodies Baxter's vision of refined and sophisticated living.

products.title: Armchair - Mickey - By Baxter
products.description_html: With its gracefully curved armrests and welcoming upholstered design, the Mickey armchair is an elegant classic that brings a comfortable touch to any space. The decorative leather profile, offered in both matching and contrasting shades, accentuates the armchair's rounded and inviting design, encouraging relaxation on its generous structure with armrests and goose-down cushions. Elegant and timeless, the Mickey is an upholstered armchair that perfectly embodies Baxter's vision of refined and sophisticated living.

products.title: Sofa - Miami Soft - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Miami Soft modular sofa adds a touch of extra comfort to the freedom of Paola Navone's outsize design, embodying Baxter's masterful ability to make leather extra-soft. The informal, versatile and welcoming character of this large modular sofa focuses all of its attention on the comfort of its guests. Placed in the centre of the living room, it invites you to take a seat on your favourite side with a simple movement of the roller backrests, facilitating complete relaxation or conversation depending on the situation.

products.title: Sofa - Miami Beach - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Relaxed and friendly elegance embellished with an extra-cosy design full of personality. These are the outstanding features of Paola Navone’s Miami Beach soft leather sofa, a statuesque piece of furniture designed to accommodate moments of relaxation and sharing. The soft rollers move when touched to form a backrest that can be adjusted to the desired comfort and allow the creation of customised backrests, supports and lumbar rests, made even more comfortable by the addition of soft leather-upholstered cushions.

products.title: Armchair - Maya - By Baxter
products.description_html: Structure: frame in rattan by Manao in brunette colour. Padding / Filling: padding in polyurethane foam with varying densities, microfiber padding with independent channel filling of dierent capacities, with acrylic fibre coating and outdoor water-repellent lining. Decoration: decorative piping in the same shade of leather. Covering / Coating: removable upholstery

products.title: Armchair - Marilyn - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The leather armchair designed by Draga&Aurel is an easy chair with a wide and comfortable seat, an ultra-light and streamlined shell with a vintage feel, and sinuous and generous forms. These are the standout features of Marilyn. Its fluid profile is reminiscent of an enveloping and comfortable nest in which to snuggle down, a warm embrace in which to sit back and relax. The swivel seat gently cradles while guaranteeing freedom of movement. Attractive yet sophisticated, young and original, thanks to its leather upholstery the armchair not only adds character to spaces but also texture and depth.

products.title: Armchair - Manila - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Light and enveloping, the Manila outdoor armchair and small armchair stand out for their tubular structure in verdigris acid-etched copper that gives an authentic and natural charm. The handcrafted weave of the technical cord covered in Lido leather enhances the soft and sinuous lines of the seat, creating a perfect balance between aesthetics and functionality. The tubular base, also made of verdigris acid-etched copper, gives stability and visual lightness. Manila is designed to enrich outdoor spaces with an exotic and unique style, perfect for creating exclusive relaxation corners in the garden or by the pool.

products.title: Armchair - Manila - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Light and enveloping, the Manila Open-Air armchair and small armchair stand out for their Manila cane structure, a lightweight, flexible and sustainable material, hand-woven with technical cord covered in Cloister or Lido leather. This combination enhances the sinuous shapes of the seat, creating a perfect balance between comfort and refinement. The tubular base in acid-etched copper gives solidity and a sophisticated touch, integrating harmoniously into the open air spaces. The Cloister and Lido leather version is enhanced by topstitching that emphasizes the meticulous craftsmanship, whereas the outdoor fabric variant is marked by double stitching, adding a refined detail. Tone-on-tone quilting completes the design with understated elegance. Manila Open-Air is designed to enrich gardens, terraces, and outdoor sheltered environments with a natural and refined style, offering exclusive and timeless relaxation corners.

products.title: Sofa - Leon - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The majestic, rounded design of the Leon sofa and swivel armchair created by the Draga & Aurel duo simultaneously conveys security and seduction with its curvy, original contours. Spirited, generous and bold, the Leon collection blends contrasts and extremes with an elegant and sophisticated harmony. On the one hand, a firm and dynamic approach, enhanced by the imposing dimensions of the pieces. On the other, an enveloping and protective roundness, which is fully expressed in the tactile sensation of the soft leather covering the seats, made even more inviting by sensory details such as pleats, reliefs and tailored stitching.

products.title: Armchair - Leggia - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Antonino Sciortino’s Leggia outdoor armchair is a perfect synthesis of leather know-how and formal purity. Its minimalist design expresses timeless elegance: a tubular structure in black powder-coated stainless steel delicately supports a suspended seat that seems to float in the air. The leather – Aku for Outdoor and Hydro for Open-Air – withstands the elements and naturally hugs the body, offering enveloping comfort and a sense of visual lightness. The large, curvy seat invites relaxation, making every moment in the open air an all-embracing sensory experience.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones Mouton - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: As a perfect combination of Studiopepe's visionary design and the enveloping softness of natural mouton, Lazy Bones Mouton rewrites the rules of comfort. This sculptural armchair stands out for its mouton upholstery available in delicate shades of air force blue, white and cream, blue, olive and turquoise, inviting you to relax with an unmistakable tactile sensation. The essential structure finds a harmonious balance thanks to its distinctive three-leg configuration, a detail that combines stability and visual lightness. The rounded lines and the wide, welcoming profile of the seat turn Lazy Bones Mouton into a piece of furniture capable of enriching any space with personality, be it a refined living room or an exclusive reading corner.

products.title: Armchair - Lazy Bones - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Lazybones is a sculptural chair designed by Studiopepe with the idea of creating a three-legged seat inspired by monoliths and primitive architecture. Characterised by archetypal forms, the chair plays with the structure’s massive volumes contrasted with the softness and comfort of the padding and leather upholstery. Lazybones is characterised by three oversized, solid and imposing legs that emphasise its archaic solemnity. Its solid design fluidly interacts with the rounded, generous shapes of the backrest, making it ideal for leisure and social occasions.

products.title: Armchair - Keren - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Keren is an innovative collection of soft leather armchairs and ottomans designed by the eclectic Christophe Delcourt for Baxter. Inspired by nature’s geometric shapes, Delcourt’s design perfectly interlocks organic and bevelled forms to create a small armchair with a harmonious seat and compact dimensions complemented by a sculptural ottoman. Two furnishing elements that dialogue in a perfect balance, capable of enhancing any room, from the living room to the dining room.

products.title: Sofa - Juliette - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Christophe Delcourt’s Juliette sofa immediately asserts itself with its clean design and extreme, almost cubist modularity. A modular, double-sided soft leather sofa that is extremely versatile and always ready to reinvent itself thanks to its low backrest. An upholstered piece that becomes an individually usable element, a seat for conversation, a chaise longue filled with cushions, a comfortable ottoman... as if it needed a pretext to show itself from every angle. Above all, Juliette is an outstanding piece with details that deserve to be observed and described one by one. The result of precise and meticulous work, this modular sofa is a beautiful tribute to creativity and savoir faire.

products.title: Armchair - Jorgen - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Jorgen armchair collection encapsulates all the enveloping elegance that characterises Roberto Lazzeroni's design in a harmonious dialogue of shapes and materials. The structure is as essential as it is comfortable, supported by a base in wengé-stained ash enriched with metal tips available in refined finishes: satin brass, hand-brushed burnished metal, or satin nickel. The soft leather upholstery is embellished with a decorative piping that echoes the leather tones of the backrest and seat, achieving a sophisticated chromatic continuity. The armchair's flowing, cosy lines invite you to relax, while the balance of wood and leather lends a distinctive character, ideal for adding style and warmth to spaces.

products.title: Sofa - Jo - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The Jo leather sofa and armchair embody Draga & Aurel's desire for spontaneity. Modular, versatile and incredibly comfortable, this sofa and armchair have a vintage feel in terms of their profiles and materials. The wide saddle leather seat is supported by an extremely light, almost suspended, luminous metal frame. The overall effect is completed with large cushions that can be moved around to create different looks each time.

products.title: Ottoman - Istanbul - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The upholstered Istanbul ottomans designed by Paola Navone for Baxter offer a sensory experience of comfort and softness. Perfect in any environment, these upholstered and leather-covered seats not only decorate spaces with the sinuous lines of their design, but also create an extra cosy oasis for relaxing breaks and convivial moments. The versatility of the Istanbul ottomans makes them ideal elements to complete any space and offer a resting experience that is as elegant as it is comfortable.

products.title: Armchair - Inga - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: An exclusive creation by Roberto Lazzeroni for Baxter, the Inga pouf captivates with its minimal, refined charm. Its gently flared cylindrical shape features carefully placed openings at the front and back, lending the piece a pleasing visual lightness and a modern aesthetic. The small, curved backrest blends seamlessly into the base, embracing the sitter with understated comfort—ideal for welcoming contemporary lounge spaces. Fully upholstered in fine leather, this elegant pouf embodies the excellence of Baxter’s Italian design, making it the perfect addition to exclusive living rooms, distinctive interiors, and luxury hospitality environments.

products.title: Armchair - Houston - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Comfortable and eclectic, the Houston armchair designed by Paola Navone for Baxter is the result of the creative impulse of a design that is both versatile and multifaceted. The armchair's simple, elegant contours are made unmistakable by an innovative design that combines materials as diverse as the brushed ash wood of the base, the polished cast aluminium shell, and the soft leather that covers the seat and back cushions. The armchair’s distinguishing feature is its contrast between rigidity and softness, between the support of the shell and the soft padding that creates the effect of an enveloping cot in which to experience moments of comfort and togetherness.

products.title: Sofa - Housse XXL - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Paola Navone’s Housse XXL sofa represents the ultimate expression of comfort, combined with a classic and elegant aesthetic capable of elevating any room. With its majestic proportions and imposing structure, the large sofa offers unique cosiness, made irresistible by the deep seat, which envelops the guest in a spacious and relaxing nest. Leather upholstery characterises the sofa with a soft drape along the entire frame. Every detail is enhanced by the topstitching, which finely outlines the contours of the cushions, adding personality and style to the surroundings.

products.title: Sofa - Housse Mono - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The large Housse Mono armless sofa designed by Paola Navone for Baxter offers an uncompromising comfort experience, enhanced by a minimalist and extra-comfortable design. The clean design and wide, slightly reclining sofa frame create a cosy atmosphere, ideal for relaxation and socializing. The upholstered seat, consisting of three large cushions upholstered in leather and finished with topstitching, emphasises a minimalist and harmonious aesthetic that transforms any space into a sophisticated place. Perfect for those looking for a cosy and stylistically impeccable sofa.

products.title: Armchair - Housse Extra - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Cosy, comfortable, and elegant, the Housse Extra armchair designed by Paola Navone for Baxter takes the experience of comfort to the next level with its iconic extra-large seat. The design is classic and refined, made monumental by a solid frame that supports the generous volumes of the upholstered cushions, ready to welcome you for a relaxing break. Like a fabric, leather covers the armchair’s soft elements, finishing it off with refined stitching that enhances its sophisticated, informal style.

products.title: Sofa - Housse - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The simple shape of a classic sofa is combined with the sophisticated, extra-comfortable contours typical of Paola Navone, who with Housse creates the perfect combination of style and comfort. Housse represents the ideal combination of a distinctive design – characterised by the soft volumes of the seat and back cushions – and unparalleled elegance, enhanced by the leather upholstery, which is worked like a fabric and finished with topstitching. Every detail is designed to provide an optimal relaxation experience, a cosy nest in which to enjoy a restful break.

products.title: Sofa - Himba - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: The Himba collection redefines interiors and exteriors with ethnic-inspired and natural looking furniture. Sofas, loungers and armchairs designed by Roberto Lazzeroni to become majestic presences in the home as well as in the garden, blending into nature and acquiring character and meaning over time. Remarkably delicate and made even more welcoming by the cushions, the pieces in the collection are like exotic sculptures and can be used both in the living room and outside the home thanks to the leather (indoor or outdoor) and fabric (outdoor) covers.

products.title: Armchair - Hakuna Matata - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Hakuna Matata is the solid wood armchair designed by Roberto Lazzeroni to celebrate moments of quiet relaxation both indoors and out. The name itself is a statement of intent: “carefree” in Swahili, it advocates a slower and more rejuvenating approach to moments of relaxation and rest. Its reassuring sculpted design is inspired by African art and its alternation of defined and compact curves invites us to abandon ourselves in its generous embrace.

products.title: Armchair - Hakuna Matata - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Hakuna Matata is the solid wood armchair designed by Roberto Lazzeroni to celebrate moments of quiet relaxation both indoors and out. The name itself is a statement of intent: “carefree” in Swahili, it advocates a slower and more rejuvenating approach to moments of relaxation and rest.
