products.title: Armchair - Greta Special Edition Printed - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The Special Edition Printed version of the sophisticated Greta armchair features two new, exquisite decorations on the leather upholstery with eclectic and unusual prints and patterns, making the seat an example of style and creativity. The leather is screen-printed by hand with prints inspired by 1950s textile archive designs, transferring textures usually associated with fabrics to leather. The frame designed by Draga&Aurel is reclining, wide and comfortable, finished in shellac and featuring wide edging in satin-finished brass, hand-brushed burnished metal or nickel-plated and satin-finished metal. The soft upholstery of the seat and back cushions ensures enveloping comfort, making Greta the perfect chair for relaxing and social moments.

products.title: Armchair - Greta - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: With its cosy and sophisticated design, the Greta armchair by Draga&Aurel invites you to relax and enjoy the comfort that the reclining seat inspires from the first glance. Large and inviting, the armchair’s comfortable seat is distinguished by the functional ergonomics provided by the tilt of the base structure, which accompanies the guest into an oasis of relaxation. The statuesque solidity of the frame, edged with a fine metal finish of your choice, is balanced by the softness of the upholstered seat and backrest cushions, upholstered in leather in a variety of colours, patterns and textures, including the eclectic Greta Special Edition Printed print.

products.title: Sofa - Girgenti - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Antonino Sciortino’s projects arise from a need for functionality and versatility, from the choice of a linear aesthetic that makes minimalism the point of design. Girgenti is an outdoor sofa with a metal frame that performs its function using the fewest possible elements. The sofa’s minimalist frame, like that of the ottoman that completes it, is made of matt black painted galvanised metal rod. It divides spaces with precise, geometric graphic lines, creating a rectangular base that supports the seat cushions as well as the decorative cushions, both of which can be upholstered in leather or outdoor fabric to perfectly suit Open Air environments.

products.title: Armchair - Ginevra - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Ginevra armchair by Paola Navone reinterprets the classic bergère, transforming it into a contemporary refuge of pure comfort. A soft architecture of skilfully orchestrated cushions creates a seating experience that embraces and supports with extraordinary naturalness. Baxter leather, chosen for its exceptional lightness and flexibility, reveals a natural elegance that adapts effortlessly to form, creating a landscape of waves and folds that speak to the authenticity of the material. Every detail reflects a liberation from formal constraints: the swivel base brings dynamism to the seating experience, while the matching pouffe completes this oasis of relaxation. Ginevra is not simply a designer armchair: it is a daily invitation to rediscover the pleasure of surrender. A distinctive element that enhances any contemporary interior with its welcoming presence.

products.title: Sofa - Ginestra Openair - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: The brainchild of designer Antonino Sciortino, Ginestra is a matt black galvanised metal outdoor sofa that elevates any open-air environment. The small sofa has a design that is both striking and functional at the same time, a precise arrangement of metal rods creating sinuous contours that filter space, light and air. The high vertical backrest conveys a rhythmic, graceful dynamism, while the upholstered seat cushion is covered in fabrics and leathers designed for sheltered outdoor areas such as patios and terraces.

products.title: Sofa - Ginestra - By Antonino Sciortino
products.description_html: Antonino Sciortino’s Ginestra chaise longue is an original symbol of everyday living, dividing the living space with the graphic play of its striking frame. Made entirely of galvanized metal rod and painted matte black, the sofa features a rhythmic pattern that alternates full and empty, curved and severe shapes. The key design element of the chaise longue is the high vertical backrest that embraces and supports the leather-upholstered cushioned seat. The decorative profile of the seat cushion draws soft shapes and wins you over with Ginestra’s unique comfort.

products.title: Sofa - Freud - By Baxter
products.description_html: With its minimalist, sophisticated design, the Freud leather bench designed by Baxter becomes the star of the space and assumes the characteristics of a versatile, timeless accessory. At once a bench, chaise longue and relaxing dormeuse, Freud adapts to the uses and circumstances of life, guaranteeing maximum comfort thanks to the option to add a soft roller headrest cushion secured by the leather belt. The raw-cut stitching of the upholstery accentuates the padding of the large upper cushion and lends a unique elegance to the structure’s sleek design.

products.title: Sofa - Fold - By Vincenzo De Cotiis
products.description_html: A masterpiece by Vincenzo De Cotiis, the Fold sofa takes its name from the captivating play of folds in the leather that envelops it, creating a distinctive texture with powerful visual impact. This unique element turns the surface into a tactile landscape—an expression of refined craftsmanship and aesthetic exploration. The shape is soft, enveloping and minimalist, containing in its purity traces of the long process of upholstery manufacture. The solid antiqued brass feet that support the sofa’s low frame are only present at the front, emphasising the unique and sophisticated style of a piece that elevates any space in which it is placed. Fold is not merely a sofa; it is a sculptural presence that transforms its surroundings—a contemporary design piece that enriches the space with its quiet elegance and unmistakable personality.

products.title: Armchair - Etienne Bergère - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Blending art and design, the Etienne Bergère armchair combines the sculptural features typical of Roberto Lazzeroni with elegant contours reduced to their essence, creating a sense of lightness thanks to the swivel metal base detail. This majestic and sinuous bergère armchair naturally encourages contemplation in the enveloping curves of its seat cushions and high leather-upholstered backrest, which seems to want to embrace the user. The addition of soft cushions and the ability to construct the shell and seat with different leather and colour variants make Etienne Bergère even more unique and versatile.

products.title: Armchair - Elli - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Featuring a compact design formed by interlocking rounded geometric shapes, the Elli armchair by Christophe Delcourt is an eclectic seat that attracts attention in any room. Without armrests, like the palaver chairs that inspired it, Elli combines architectural design with an idea of comfort and sharing that invites idleness and conversation. The result is an interplay of soft, refined shapes, enhanced by the comfortable upholstered cushions of the wide seat and backrest.

products.title: Sofa - Elephant - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Elephant outdoor sofa and armchair designed by Paola Navone for Baxter feature all of the designer’s typical elements, enhanced here by the use of innovative materials and refined finishes. The etched copper frame for the Open-Air version (available in the Verderame finish for the Outdoor version) of the large sofa and armchair is the linear element that contrasts with the voluminous quilted upholstery of the seat and backrest. These generous cushions are available in a wide variety of materials, such as Cloister and Lido leather (or fabric) upholstery for the Open-Air collection designed for more sheltered areas. Alternatively, there are durable cushion covers made of Lido leather or water-repellent double-stitched fabric for the Outdoor collection.

products.title: Sofa - Eileen- By Baxter
products.description_html: Designed by Baxter P., Eileen is a modular outdoor sofa that transcends the boundary between sophisticated comfort and contemporary versatility. A soft oasis of relaxation suspended in the open air, it features an enveloping armchair and a complementary pouf that converse in perfect harmony—offering endless configuration possibilities to transform any outdoor setting into an exclusive living experience. Its cleverly designed proportions make it the ideal element for intimate patios, urban terraces and architectural loggias, as well as for generously sized rooms. The base module reveals its transformative nature with a simple shift of the backrest, evolving into an elegant sunbed that invites quiet contemplation of the sky above. Refined leather detailing traces its silhouette, while the grisdoré antiqued steel finish reflects Baxter’s signature design excellence—where form and function merge in harmony, celebrating the art of outdoor living with unmistakable character.

products.title: Armchair - Diner - By Piero Lissoni
products.description_html: An armchair with an authoritative personality and classic, timeless design. Diner is the elegant armchair designed by Piero Lissoni for Baxter, the result of a continuous pursuit of formal essence and pure lines, made unusual by the inviting design of the armrests. Available in numerous leather versions, Diner is the ideal home armchair with its understated comfort, made even more complete by the option of adding footrest ottomans and large upholstered cushions.

products.title: Armchair - Dharma - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Dharma is a collection of elegant and unusual furniture items whose designs - the product of a collaboration with Studiopepe - go beyond the concept of modern. Their unconventional and evocative appearance totally sets them apart from other Baxter solutions. The stools, armchairs, benches and loungers of the collection look like sculptures, polished yet informal, statuesque yet dynamic, with painted surfaces that conceal a core composed of natural materials. Surprisingly comfortable and enveloping thanks to weatherproof cushions and mattresses, these seats can be combined or used individually in both the living room and the garden.

products.title: Bench - Dharma - By Studiopepe

products.title: Sofa - Damasco - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Destructured and oversized, featuring a soft, rounded shape, Paola Navone’s Damasco sectional sofa moves away from the traditional image of an upholstered leather sofa through simplified forms and a relaxed, extra-comfortable design. Formed of upholstered modules with extra-large volumes, the seat is large, comfortable and enveloping. Whether an ottoman, dormeuse or love seat, each sofa module features leather upholstery stitched with the typical raw cut, a distinctive detail of the designer’s projects, which elevates its tactile and informal appearance.

products.title: Armchair - Dalma - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: The Dalma tufted leather armchair and sofa by designers Draga&Aurel elevate every space with sophisticated, incisive elegance, the result of a minimalist design that blends the vintage contours of ’60s furniture with those of classic tufted sofas. The backrest upholstery in soft, hand-quilted leather provides a pleasant tactile sensation and is the hallmark of Dalma seating. The supporting structure of the small sofa and armchair is made of black lacquered beech wood or Canaletto walnut, a material that also envelops the back of the backrest, which curves to invite the guest in like a welcoming gesture.

products.title: Armchair - Dabliou - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Designed by Studiopepe for Baxter, the Dabliou armchair is an outdoor piece that distils the spirit of Italy’s legendary 1960s beach resorts into a contemporary expression of elegant ease. Its design, a perfect balance between clean lines and carefully measured proportions, combines visual lightness with reassuring solidity—thanks to the use of a coloured tubular metal frame that sketches a timeless geometric silhouette. The padding, crafted to coexist gracefully with the natural elements and endure their shifting moods, welcomes the body in a soft, embracing gesture—never compromising on aesthetic clarity or elegance. Dabliou makes a subtle statement in outdoor environments, turning panoramic terraces, private gardens, and poolside areas into unique, character-filled settings—where design is not only seen, but felt. An essential, versatile piece, Dabliou is ideal both as a standalone statement and as part of a curated composition, creating a refined and harmonious living setting.

products.title: Sofa - Clara- By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Commanding centre stage in the domestic setting, the Clara leather sofa by Christophe Delcourt is a modular piece that can transform the living room into an ever-changing and enjoyably versatile creative experience. A modular leather sofa which, through the combination of numerous elements, can be used to create different seating arrangements every time: joints, solids and voids, concave and convex curves for a dynamic and constantly evolving living room.

products.title: Sofa - Chicago- By Paola Navone
products.description_html: An exclusive creation by Paola Navone, the Chicago sofa redefines the very essence of contemporary relaxation. Its generously rounded forms create a haven of sophisticated comfort — where surrendering to stillness becomes a complete sensorial experience.Every curve is designed to cradle the body in a protective embrace, while the delicate stitching — with its subtle interplay of tensions — enhances the sense of infinite softness. The Baxter leather, selected for its exceptional quality, adapts with effortless elegance to the sofa’s sinuous shape — breathing and evolving over time with use. This design piece becomes the heart of the living space: an island of pure wellbeing where time gently slows. Chicago is more than a piece of furniture — it is a statement of style that transforms the living space into a multisensory experience of true comfort.

products.title: Sofa - Chester Moon - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The sofa and armchair of the Baxter Chester Moon collection are born from a reinterpretation of the classic Chesterfield, the most iconic and beloved of upholstered furniture models, today as yesterday. Paola Navone's sophisticated design combines balanced forms, distinctive features of any Chesterfield, with the complex techniques used to craft the product. From the unique workmanship of the quilted leather, with the continuous tufting on all surfaces, to the painstaking attention paid to each button, the devil of this particular concept is in the detail. The Chester Moon sofa and armchair revisit the past in terms of the classic techniques involved in their creation, but also reveal a quest for minimalism in the cleanliness of their lines which, soft and rounded, promote a completely new living experience.

products.title: Armchair - Charlotte Longe - By Giuseppe Manzoni
products.description_html: Charlotte Longe by Baxter embodies a refined reinterpretation of classic design, combining tradition and comfort in a harmonious balance. Its rounded armrests, with a more classic profile, lend elegance and cosiness, while its solidity guarantees strength and stability. The padding and leather upholstery provide enveloping comfort and optimum support, while the wooden feet, enhanced by elegant castors in polished brass or chrome-plated metal, combine functionality and style. To complete the proposal, Charlotte Longe is paired with a coordinated footrest ottoman, perfect for elevating the relaxation experience and providing additional versatility. A piece of furniture that blends naturally into both classic and modern interiors.

products.title: Sofa - Casablanca - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, the Casablanca sofa stands out for its simple and minimalist forms, for its soft and rounded lines that urge you to treat yourselves and surrender to its cosy embrace. Impressive in size, this leather upholstered sofa immediately catches the eye and becomes the absolute centrepiece of the living room. The generous cushions formed by the folds of the armrests and backrest, which can be positioned as desired, are pure temptation and the common thread that runs through the Casablanca collection. For resting, reading, meditating and dreaming, but also for enjoying a movie, this majestic sofa is designed for moments of total relaxation and adds style and originality to any room.

products.title: Sofa - Budapest Soft- By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Budapest Soft is a cosy leather sofa that stands out for its clean and simple design, emblematic of the elegant comfort that characterises Baxter upholstered furniture. Paola Navone designs a model with majestic dimensions that immediately becomes the focal point of the living room. The seat is wide and enveloping, made even more welcoming by the possibility of adding big soft cushions in which to sink. The details make the difference: the raw-edge stitching, the soft leather and the ability to compose your preferred shape make Budapest Soft a sofa that is as exclusive as it is versatile, a model that catches the eye and tempts you to indulge in a moment of carefree relaxation.

products.title: Sofa - Budapest - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: A timeless icon is born from simplicity. The Budapest sofa, the first designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, represents the elegance of minimalism, of a linear and modular design that provides almost unexpected comfort. The rigid shell contains the large, enveloping seat cushions, limited by volumes that are only rigorous in appearance. The feeling of comfort is enhanced by the addition of ottomans and soft decorative cushions. The stitching details of the leather upholstery give the Budapest sofa a feeling of sophisticated naturalness, making it the centrepiece of any room.

products.title: Armchair - Bruxelles - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Paola Navone’s comfortable and eclectic design is perfectly expressed in Bruxelles, the comfortable armchair with a large silhouette that invites you to indulge in a totally relaxing break. The result of a creative and functional drive for comfort, the large armchair has a minimalist, almost rigorous design that makes it suitable for any context. The raw-cut stitching on the leather invites a tactile experience, while the deep seat contrasts with the geometric shape of the leather-covered armrests and tubular supports, creating an appealing balance of opposites.

products.title: Sofa - Brigitte - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: A generous design and maximum comfort: the Brigitte sofa and armchair collection by Draga Aurel revives the 1970s styles typical of the design studio to create two iconic additions, distinguished by their large size and extreme comfort. The extra-padded cushions of the large seat are upholstered in soft leather and supported by two curvy and comfortable shaped side armrests, making Brigitte the ideal sofa for indulging in moments of leisure and relaxation.

products.title: Ottoman - Bongo - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Bongo ottoman designed by Paola Navone, with its ethnic and minimalist design, becomes the elegant centrepiece of the living space. The ottoman’s iconic shape – reminiscent of the sculptural forms of African drums – is an ironic invitation to sit and enjoy social moments. The formal aspect is carefully designed down to the smallest detail by the exquisite workmanship of the raw-edge leather stitching, which outlines sinuous and enveloping shapes and gives the seat a unique and original appearance.

products.title: Armchair - Berlino - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: With Berlino, Paola Navone has designed an iconic armchair with a classic, elegant silhouette which, thanks to its sloping backrest, invites you to relax and share. Upholstered in soft leather, this inviting armchair is made even more comfortable by the goose-down padding used for the cushions, while the metal feet – available with a brushed metal or gunmetal finish – make Berlino an extremely stylish chair that suits any room.

products.title: Sofa - Bergere Longe - By Baxter
products.description_html: With the Bergère Longe collection, Baxter celebrates timeless elegance with an armchair and sofa that combine comfort and sophistication. The leather upholstered seat and backrest cushions cradle you with a soft and inviting embrace. The wooden feet, offered in various finishes, enhance the design with an elegant natural feel, complemented by a decorative profile in matching leather that can be customised with other shades from the catalogue. The Bergère Longe collection stands out as an invitation to relax, seamlessly fitting into any setting owing to its superb balance of timeless design and contemporary touches.

products.title: Decorative Cushions - Belle De Jour - By Matteo Thun & Antonio Rodriguez
products.description_html: The Belle De Jour collection of leather cushions designed by Matteo Thun and Antonio Rodriguez for Baxter expresses all the craftsmanship of leather processing, which transforms the material into a small masterpiece of design. Each decorative cushion is padded with soft goose down and upholstered in soft leather with a smooth effect or, in the special edition, folded and pleated by hand like high-fashion skirts. The result is a series of exclusive and comfortable cushions with a sophisticated striped pattern, which add a touch of sophistication to the bed as well as the sofa.

products.title: Ottoman - Beki - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: Beki is the sectional ottoman designed by Christophe Delcourt for Baxter, a piece of furniture with a sculptural and striking design that permits creative combinations and ever new informal uses. Each of the modules can be combined with other Beki ottomans using magnets, making this seat ideal for furnishing art galleries and installations. Like river stones with rounded, irregular corners, the ottoman’s components adjust the space to create comfortable seating areas that invite socialising and relaxation, ensuring maximum comfort thanks to the leather upholstery.

products.title: Armchair - Barret - By Draga & Aurela
products.description_html: The Barret armchair by the Draga&Aurel design studio completes the idea of comfort with an extra-large seat enclosed by a rigid shell that reinterprets the sophisticated shapes of 1970s furniture. Featuring an ergonomic and generous design, this swivel armchair is embellished with soft curled leather upholstery that makes the upholstery even softer to the touch. The low, deep and enveloping seat makes Barret a sophisticated refuge, a nest in which to sink for maximum relaxation.

products.title: Sofa - Aura - By Hannes Peer
products.description_html: From the creative vision of Hannes Peer comes Aura, a modular leather sofa that transforms the living space with its unmistakable essential elegance, evoking the luminous, refined charm of Californian architecture. Its suspended base, refined and multifunctional, supports generous cushions with fluid elegance—offering a seating experience defined by uncompromising comfort. Aura invites personalisation through ever-changing configurations, adapting effortlessly to different needs—whether intimate or convivial. A perfect balance between a bold, steel-accented structure and the sinuous lines of its modular components makes Aura a design piece that stands out without overwhelming the space. It becomes an island of comfort, redefining the very notion of contemporary relaxation.

products.title: Armchair- Artik - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Upholstered in very soft Mongolian fur, Paola Navone’s Artik armchair is a seat with enveloping irony, ideal for warming the atmosphere of a chalet or home. Surrendering to the warm Mongolian embrace of this swivel base armchair feels like taking refuge in a nest created for cradling and cuddling in all seasons. Available in five colour varieties – white, camel, blue, green, bright orange and leather – the soft Mongolian fur that covers the armchair proves to be the most cosy material for relaxing at home.

products.title: Sofa - Arizona - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: Paola Navone’s collaboration with Baxter has resulted in the Arizona sofa, a modular, durable and lightweight chair available in both an Outdoor version, for open spaces such as a poolside or garden, and Open-air version, for more sheltered areas such as a veranda Featuring a design that is minimalist and comfortable at the same time, the Arizona modules allow you to play with the lounger, ottoman and chaise-lounge, adapting to various needs. The mix of materials available makes each piece unique. The tubular structure made of acid-etched copper in the Open Air version and in the fine Verderame finish in the Outdoor model lends it a mobile, versatile character, while the wide choice of outdoor leathers and fabrics permits completely original combinations and matches.

products.title: Sofa - Anais - By Draga & Aurel
products.description_html: With its minimalist, sophisticated design, the Anais armchair and ottoman collection expresses all the discreet, vintage-inspired 1970s elegance typical of Draga&Aurel products. The formal precision of the refined chair, which rests on a solid metal base, is softened by the enveloping, upholstered embrace of the backrest. Featuring a shape distinguished by its austere comfort, Anais invites you to take a break on one of the square or circular seats of the three ottomans, highly versatile elements that can enhance any environment and context. From the living room to the wardrobe and bedroom.

products.title: Armchair - Amburgo Baby Mouton - By Paola Navone
products.description_html: The Amburgo Baby armchair, designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, features a rounded, reassuring design that recalls the classic ideal of the home armchair. The curved shape of the accessory forms an extra-comfortable upholstered seat with wide armrests and an enveloping backrest that seems to want to embrace the sitter, encircling them in a comfortable and secure embrace. Featuring a compact, neat size, this rounded armchair is enhanced by the original decorative profile in contrasting or tone-on-tone leather, which further enhances its curved, soft design.

products.description_html: The Amburgo Baby armchair, designed by Paola Navone for Baxter, features a rounded, reassuring design that recalls the classic ideal of the home armchair. products.title: Sofa - Alfred - By Marco Milisich
products.description_html: Designed by Marco Milisich, the Alfred leather sofa is a project with an iconic soul, breaking away from the classic rules of upholstered furniture and acquiring, over time, all the charm of a time-worn piece. Alfred’s unique character can be appreciated above all in its original vintage version, where the special technique of giving the leather an antique finish lends it a unique appearance, making each piece irreplaceable and increasingly distinctive as time passes.

products.title: Armchair - Aimée - By Christophe Delcourt
products.description_html: More than a mere armchair, Aimée is an invitation—an embrace of comfort, a sculptural gesture shaped by motion itself. Its design is born of a perfect balance between structure and fluidity, where every curve is crafted to cradle, support, and caress. Upholstered in Baxter’s signature leather—soft, tactile, and rich in character—Aimée clings naturally to its form, with an elasticity that gives the piece a gently sculpted feel. Smooth, continuous surfaces enhance the piece’s authentic allure, celebrating the sensual depth and tonal richness of the material. Aimée embodies Christophe Delcourt’s refined design philosophy: a marriage of formal exploration and material excellence. Generous in its proportions and innately welcoming, it is a seat designed to fit seamlessly into any space, enhancing its atmosphere while offering a pure, cocooning sense of wellbeing. A timeless object, capable of transforming each moment of rest into a quiet ritual of comfort.

products.title: Sofa - Adel - By Baxter
products.description_html: Baxter’s Adel collection reworks the concept of a bench and ottoman with a completely original twist, creating an interplay of sinuous contours that join and follow each other in a harmonious rhythm of curves. The design of the ottoman and bench has an unusual but highly versatile character, offering novel design ideas both within a living room – as social seating – and as support elements that can enhance art galleries and installations.

products.title: Lamp - Nuvola
products.description_html: "Having your head in the clouds" means forgetting about your worries for a moment, freeing your mind and giving space to your imagination. The Nuvola lamp collection designed by Draga & Aurel for Baxter conveys this sense of freedom and allows you to explore new horizons thanks to lighting solutions that resemble works of art. The chosen material for this dreamy environment is white fibreglass which, rich in visible textures and modelled in undulating, light and sinuous forms, is reminiscent of a cloud that gently reveals the sunlight.
